Name: Stardew Universe
Author: SXFighter
Description:
[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/stardew_universe-jpg.162990/[/img]


I haven't been playing SV long at all, but it's really cool, and I love the potential for total conversion.

I now have vague plans to do a Steven Universe total conversion,
starting with this rough sprite sheet replacing Vincent with Steven!

Keep in mind that this is my first ever attempt at pixel art and it's a little awkward (mostly the hair.)

Steven V.1

[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/vincent-png.162989/[/img]



[u][b]!New![/b][/u] Placeholder Steven Portrait


[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/vincent-png.163060/[/img]


I tried to make a portrait based on Vincent's but it ended up looking
pretty comical in a bad way. So I edited screenshots from the show. I
hope someone awesome will step up and make some charming ones from
scratch.

I plan on changing dialogue too but I'd love any contributions! (Art/Ideas/Coding/Etc.)

Constructive criticism is welcome.

You have permission to edit this as long as you credit me and allow me
to incorporate your edits into the main package if I feel that they are
better.
